messages.subject: tsDyn: new version 0.9-43
parts:
Hi everyone

A new version of tsDyn just made its way through CRAN, version 0.9-43
(containing also update 0.9-42 not published on CRAN). The main
improvement is a rewriting of the predict.VECM/VAR, VAR.sim, which made
the code easier, and allows to predict with exogeneous values.
Incidentally, it corrects a few mistakes discovered, so that predictions
containing trends are now more accurate. Besides of this, it contains
the update fixes minor issues, see below for details

Best

Matthieu

Version 0.9-43: Matthieu Stigler (23/4/2015)
-minor fixes: add checking in selectLSTAR in case of convergence
issue, rename lstar.Rout.save as created issues on other platforms

Version 0.9-42: Matthieu Stigler (15/4/2015) never published on CRAN
-full rewrite of VAR.sim, VAR.gen, now cleaner, allows for exogeneous
predictions, etc.
-remove predict.VECM
-fix small issue in DESC file (pkg description in title case, only one
maintainer).
